title: Staffing Matcher — availability-aware ranked shortlist
intelligence_boundary_rule: Every ranking/availability judgement routes through the INJECTED Claude double (no live API). Assertions target the call boundary, the Zod-validated shape, the result RELATIONSHIP (in-window ranked above equally-skilled out-of-window via rank/inRequestedWindow), graceful failure, and role-scope — never a literal the mock scripted, never code-side keyword/regex/date logic.
binding_contract_decision: The authored acceptance test (artifacts/02-acceptance-tests/e2e-tests/staffing-matcher.test.ts) is ADAPTED into the repo harness at tests/staffing-matcher.test.ts. The four AC blocks (AC-04/05/21/06) are carried in intent; the 15-scenario plan's additive scenarios (schema coercion, prompt cache placement, dataset role-scope/determinism, garbled-JSON failure, Opus routing, transport) are added per the plan's Phase 0 guidance. F-01 fix: tests/setup/test-helpers.ts extended with loadModule + SYNTHETIC_PROFILES so the suite can import.
performance_tests_rationale: SKILL-3 reads through a single injected Claude call with no DB writes; latency is dominated by the model (Opus) and handled via prompt caching + a UI loading state deferred to SKILL-6. No backend throughput/batch surface to load-test in this story. Not applicable per the agent's Step-5 matrix.
